title: perf(app-shell): Home's navigation roster gate asks its required objects in one ?names= request
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoHb1GehvoiX4DcV3e24Gypu)_

Fixes #29444

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Console 首页（应用外）导航名册的「对象是否存在」门禁，现在把所有 `requiresObject` 对象名合成一次 `GET /meta/object?names=a,b,c` 读取，不再每个对象名发一次请求。
- 为什么改：app-crm 首页每次打开都要为这道门禁发 9 个对象元数据请求；服务端 `?names=` 批量读（#29236 裁决 A，PR #30709）已上线，实测改后只剩 1 个。
- 风险与回滚：只影响应用外（首页等没有当前应用的页面）；应用内仍逐个按名读，记录表单继续与数据适配器共用那次读取。批量答案里缺的名字按 404 处理（入口隐藏），请求失败则所有名字都算未答（入口照常显示），与原来逐个读的行为一致。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` 的 `fetchScopeNames`（缺名、失败、刷新三种情形）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts` 里 `outsideApp` 那一处分支；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/homeObjectReads-29121.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/homeObjectReads-29121.test.tsx`，预期 7 个用例全绿，其中门禁用例只记到一条 `object?names=sys_cloud_only,sys_queue` 请求。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- **席位意见**：ui 席 2 对照 head `382ce259` 的 diff 复核：5 个文件、+221 / −26，只在 app 外（首页）把路由门要的对象并成一次 `GET /meta/object?names=` 读；缺名照旧算未注册（同按名 404），整次读失败则每个名都算未答（同按名读失败），刷新再并读一次，预览与 app 内仍按名读，路由读者不会拿列表回答当自己的。`MetadataContextValue` 类型未改（钩子内本地类型转交 `batch`），无新导出，Clause-② no 成立，不欠契约复审；382ce259 只改测试以过 Lint UI。CI 全绿，同意落地。

## What changes

- **The roster gate outside an app asks once.** `useNavMemberGates` reads the app list's `requiresObject` union through the names-only scope. Outside an app (a frame whose app has no `name`: Home, or a frame with no expression scope), it now passes a package-local `batch: true` hand-off beside `views: false`. Inside an app nothing changes: the union is still read by name, because the route's own objects are among those names and their by-name read is shared with the adapter's `getObjectSchema` cache (objectui#13044).
- **The provider answers the hand-off from its own scope entry.** `MetadataProvider.readObjectScope` keys a batched read under `NAMES_BATCH_SCOPE`, a symbol, so no package id can collide with it. It never shares the names-only entry: a list answer carries no by-name envelope and cannot tell an absent object from a refused one (`OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`), so a route reader never takes it for its own. The names not asked yet go out in one `meta.getItems('object', { names })` (the client door PR #30709 added; no new URL builder).
  - A name in the answer is answered with its definition, through the same list ingestion as every object list (`ingestObjectList`).
  - A name the answer leaves out is answered missing, exactly as a by-name `404` was (ruling A on #29236, 6580261740: an unknown name is simply absent).
  - A read that gets no answer fails every name it asked, as a failed by-name read failed its one (objectui#13009, objectui#13052). The gate shows those entries and does not ask again until `invalidate`, `refresh` or an organization switch.
  - Only the asked names are read out of the answer, so an item the request did not name never lands in the scope.
  - `refresh` asks the batched names again in one request.
  - Under the draft preview, whose `MetadataClient.list` has no names filter, the hand-off falls back to the names-only scope (by name).
- **Same filtering as the by-name read (measured on `main` b6182249).** The list door runs `?names=` after the per-caller list gate (whose `object` arm is the by-name read's `filterObjectListViewsForUser`) and before the ADR-0106 mask and translation. The store read drops a disabled package's objects, where the by-name read refuses them `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`. The gate reads both answers as "not registered". The answer is the `{ type, items: [...] }` array envelope, which `extractItems` already reads.
- No new export from `@object-ui/app-shell`. The hand-off type `ReadNamesInOneRequest` is local to `useNavMemberGates.ts`.

## Tests

- `homeObjectReads-29121.test.tsx` (real `MetadataProvider` + real gate, fake adapter):
  - Outside an app, the gate sends one `object?names=sys_cloud_only,sys_queue` request. The absent `sys_cloud_only` is hidden and `sys_queue` is shown. This replaces the two by-name reads the case pinned before.
  - A batch that rejects leaves both entries shown and is not asked again.
  - `refresh('object')` re-asks the names in one request.
- `navGateUnionScope-12980.test.tsx`: the outside-app case asserts the single `?names=` request for the five-name union. Its fake adapter now honours `names` the way the door does: it keeps those items, and an unknown name is absent. The package-less-app cases (inside an app, by name) are unchanged and green.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which confirmed the mutation landed and the restore matched the HEAD blob:
  - gate hand-off off (`outsideApp = false`): 2 cases red;
  - absent name not recorded missing: 1 red;
  - refresh asks by name: 1 red.

<details><summary>Related suite (347 files that import the provider or the gate)</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over every app-shell / console test that names `readObjectScope`, `useNavMemberGates` or `MetadataProvider`, before the union-scope pin below was updated. 345 files passed and 2 failed:

- `navGateUnionScope-12980` (outside-app case): its fake adapter ignored `names`. Updated above, and the file is now 12/12 with the Home file.
- `spec-symbol-parity.test.ts`: 16 cases failed because the probe reads `@objectstack/spec`'s `.d.ts` files, and that run's build used `OS_SKIP_DTS=1` (`SPEC_NAMES.size` 0). After a declarations build, the file is green together with the two gate files: 3 files, 53 tests.
</details>

## Verification

Live, on app-crm. Backend `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4417` in `examples/app-crm`. Console `vite --port 5197 --strictPort` with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET` pointed at it. Headless Chromium signed in as the seeded admin, then loaded `/home` fresh, counting every request whose path starts with `/api/v1/meta/object`.

| Tree | Roster gate requests | Other object reads on Home |
|---|---|---|
| `origin/main` (the two source files restored from b6182249) | 9: `GET /meta/object/NAME` for `sys_assignment_rule`, `sys_business_unit`, `sys_notification`, `sys_notification_preference`, `sys_notification_template`, `sys_queue`, `sys_queue_member`, `sys_record_share`, `sys_sharing_rule` | 1 (`sys_activity`, the activity feed's presence check) |
| this branch | **1**: `GET /meta/object?names=` with the same nine names, 200, 9 items | 1 (`sys_activity`, unchanged) |

The card counted 8 names on app-crm. The app list now carries 9.

## Acceptance notes

- `sys_activity`'s by-name read on Home belongs to `useObjectPresence` (the activity feeds), not to the roster gate. It is left as it is: one name, and its by-name read is the one the adapter cache shares.
- Inside an app with no package, the gate still reads the union by name (objectstack#29416's path). Folding it too would cost the record form's shared by-name read (objectui#13044) for the route's own objects. That is not this card's acceptance, so it is noted here and not changed.
- Under the draft preview the gate keeps its by-name reads, because `MetadataClient.list` in `@object-ui/data-objectstack` has no `names` option. Adding one is a data-adapter change this card does not need.
